APIs and context for dumping instructions, transactions, blocks, syscalls, and ELF data to Protobuf.

# Purpose
Defines the Protobuf dump interface used by runtime tests to record syscalls, instructions, transactions, blocks, and ELF data for later replay and comparison. The file declares the `fd_block_dump_ctx_t` state object, which stores the block context, a list of collected transactions, and a scratchpad allocator used while building block messages. It also provides inline helpers to create, join, reset, and manage the lifetime of the dump context, plus function prototypes such as [`fd_dump_instr_to_protobuf`](<#fd_dump_instr_to_protobuf>), [`fd_dump_txn_to_protobuf`](<#fd_dump_txn_to_protobuf>), [`fd_dump_block_to_protobuf_collect_tx`](<#fd_dump_block_to_protobuf_collect_tx>), and [`fd_dump_block_to_protobuf`](<#fd_dump_block_to_protobuf>). The comments in the file also describe the command-line options and output file formats used to control and identify the dumped Protobuf records.
